en.name: USCIS Case Lookup
en.subtitle: Immigration case status
en.short_description: Track USCIS receipt numbers, processing times, the visa bulletin and NVC status.
en.description:
Case Tracker for USCIS keeps every receipt number, every processing time and every visa bulletin in one place, so you are not refreshing three government websites to work out where your case stands.

—— Track your cases ——

Save any USCIS receipt number and see its current status, with a full history of every change so you can see when your case actually moved. Track as many cases as you need — a family's petitions live side by side.

—— Know what is next ——

PROCESSING TIMES
Current posted processing times by form and service centre, so you can tell whether your case is inside or outside the normal range.

VISA BULLETIN
The monthly Department of State visa bulletin, readable on a phone, with final action and filing dates.

NVC TRACKER
Follow a case through National Visa Center stages after approval.

ALERTS
A notification when a tracked case changes status, so you do not have to keep checking.

—— Prepare and understand ——

CIVICS TEST
Practise the naturalisation civics questions with a trainer that tracks what you have learned.

RESOURCES AND GOVERNMENT SOURCES
Plain-language explanations, with a direct link to the official government page behind every figure so you can verify anything yourself.

IMPACT ADVISOR AND AI CHAT
Ask questions about the process in plain language and get an explanation of what a form or a stage means.

NEWS FEED
Policy and processing news that affects pending cases.

—— Private and offline ——

Your receipt numbers stay on your device. Sign-in is optional — tap "Continue as guest" and everything works. Once your cases are saved the app is fully usable offline.

—— Important ——

Case Tracker for USCIS is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by USCIS, the Department of State, or any government agency, and it does not provide legal advice. Always confirm anything that matters against the official government source, and consult a qualified immigration attorney about your own case.

en.release_notes:
First release of Case Tracker for USCIS.

• Track any number of USCIS receipt numbers, with full status history
• Posted processing times by form and service centre
• The monthly Department of State visa bulletin
• NVC stage tracking after approval
• Status-change alerts
• Naturalisation civics test trainer with progress tracking
• Plain-language resources, each linked to its official government source
• Works offline once your cases are saved; sign-in is optional

Not affiliated with USCIS or any government agency. Feedback: contact@safecodeg.com

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Case Tracker for USCIS keeps every receipt number, every processing time and every visa bulletin in one place, so you are not refreshing three government websites to work out where your case stands.

Intended audience:
Immigration case status

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional; the main features can be reached without signing in.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google AdMob — advertising
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.
